descriptionChirho: The innermost room of Solomon's Temple, the Holy of Holies (דְּבִיר); consistently rendered as 'inner sanctuary' (eng), 'santuario interior' (spa), 'مِحْرَاب' (arb), '지성소/내실' (kor), 'patakatifu pa ndani/chumba cha ndani' (swa) across all occurrences, with grammatical variation (article, prepositions, construct state, conjunction) being the only differentiator between clusters.
